finalText:
Build is clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). The screen full of warnings was mostly harmless deprecation noise from `fakepack`, but two real bugs from the bump were buried in there:

- `src/core/options.js` — still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')` and aborted the build.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled explicit booleans and threw on `undefined`.

Fixed both call sites to match the new shapes; the build now finishes with only the expected deprecation warnings (0 errors).
